rows.ARS:
Deep pink Shrub.
Registration name: Elodie Gossuin ®
Exhibition name: Elodie Gossuin ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dominique Massad (France, before 2007).
Introduced in France by Guillot/Roseraies Pierre Guillot in 2008 as 'Elodie Gossuin'.
Introduced in Australia by Wagner's Rose Nursery in 2020 as 'Elodie Gossuin'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong, tea rose, vanilla fragrance. Very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, old-fashioned, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
